resources.string: To run the game, some of its libraries are emulated through box64. Here you can download and install native libraries from the macOS version of the game, which need no emulation. This lowers the load on memory and the processor. Get them straight from Steam if you own the game, or load a ready archive if you downloaded them earlier.
Replaces the emulated parts of the game with native ARM64 libraries from the macOS version. Less CPU and memory load, smoother play. Build 42.20+, experimental.
Libraries are not downloaded or are incomplete. The normal libraries will be used.
Download native libraries for “%1$s”. Steam ownership and sign-in are required; the full macOS game will not be downloaded.
This instance is unavailable or does not support this feature.
Not from the macOS version: the game\'s own Android ARM64 sound library, used instead of the x86_64 one through box64. Nothing to download.

Select a ZIP with libLighting.dylib, libPZPathFind.dylib and libPZPopMan.dylib from the macOS version of Project Zomboid. Folders inside the archive do not matter. The files go to game/macos of the selected instance.
All libraries are on by default. Turn off single ones as needed: a library that is off uses its regular version.
